        pos += append_pattern(result, pos, pattern, True)

    return result

def encode(contents: str, hints: dict) -> list:
    length = len(contents)
    # Check length
    if length < 1 or length > 80:
        raise ValueError(f"Contents length should be between 1 and 80 characters, but got {length}")

    # Check for forced code set hint.
    forced_code_set = -1
    if hints is not None and EncodeHintType.FORCE_CODE_SET in hints:
        code_set_hint = str(hints[EncodeHintType.FORCE_CODE_SET])
        match code_set_hint:
            case "A":
                forced_code_set = CODE_CODE_A
            case "B":
                forced_code_set = CODE_CODE_B
            case "C":
                forced_code_set = CODE_CODE_C
            case _:
                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported code set hint: {code_set_hint}")

    # Check content
    for i, c in enumerate(contents):
        # check for non ascii characters that are not special GS1 characters
        match c:
            # special function characters
            case ESCAPE_FNC_1 | ESCAPE_FNC_2 | ESCAPE_FNC_3 | ESCAPE_FNC_4:
                continue
            # non ascii characters
            case _ if ord(c) > 127:
                raise ValueError(f"Bad character in input: ASCII value={ord(c)}")

        # check characters for compatibility with forced code set
        match (forced_code_set, c):
            case (CODE_CODE_A, _) if ord(c) > 95 and ord(c) <= 127:
                raise ValueError(f"Bad character in input for forced code set A: ASCII value={ord(c)}")
            case (CODE_CODE_B, _) if ord(c) <= 32:
                raise ValueError(f"Bad character in input for forced code set B: ASCII value={ord(c)}")
            case (CODE_CODE_C, _) if ord(c) < 48 or (ord(c) > 57 and ord(c) <= 127) or c == ESCAPE_FNC_2 or c == ESCAPE_FNC_3 or c == ESCAPE_FNC_4:
                raise ValueError(f"Bad character in input for forced code set C: ASCII value={ord(c)}")

    patterns = []  # temporary storage for patterns
    check_sum = 0
    check_weight = 1
    code_set = 0  # selected code (CODE_CODE_B or CODE_CODE_C)
    position = 0  # position in contents

    while position < length:
        # Select code to use
        new_code_set = choose_code(contents, position, code_set) if forced_code_set == -1 else forced_code_set

        # Get the pattern index
        match (new_code_set, contents[position]):
            case (_, ESCAPE_FNC_1):
                pattern_index = CODE_FNC_1
            case (_, ESCAPE_FNC_2):
                pattern_index = CODE_FNC_2
            case (_, ESCAPE_FNC_3):
                pattern_index = CODE_FNC_3
            case (_, ESCAPE_FNC_4) if code_set == CODE_CODE_A:
                pattern_index = CODE_FNC_4_A
            case (_, ESCAPE_FNC_4):
                pattern_index = CODE_FNC_4_B
            case (CODE_CODE_A, _):
                pattern_index = ord(contents[position]) - ord(' ')
                if pattern_index < 0:
                    pattern_index += ord('`')
            case (CODE_CODE_B, _):
                pattern_index = ord(contents[position]) - ord(' ')
            case (_, _):
                if position + 1 == length and new_code_set == CODE_CODE_C:
                    raise ValueError("Bad number of characters for digit only encoding.")
                pattern_index = int(contents[position:position+2])
                position += 1

        patterns.append(Code128Reader.CODE_PATTERNS[pattern_index])

        # Compute checksum
        check_sum += pattern_index * check_weight
        if position != 0:
            check_weight += 1
        position += 1

    # Compute and append checksum
    check_sum %= 103
    patterns.append(Code128Reader.CODE_PATTERNS[check_sum])

    # Append stop code
    patterns.append(Code128Reader.CODE_PATTERNS[CODE_STOP])

    # Compute code width
    code_width = sum(sum(width for width in pattern) for pattern in patterns)

    # Compute result
    result = [False] * code_width
    pos = 0
    for pattern in patterns:
        pos += append_pattern(result, pos, pattern, True)

    return result
